R2.method: Checked material continuity in y=[0,4] and annulus volume around bore

criteria.condition: Face plate >= 4mm thick with solid material around bore

R2.why: The check for 'solid material all around the central bore' uses an annulus volume comparison that is highly sensitive to probe placement and fails on a 1mm cube (which has no plate), but more importantly, it reports a failure on the real part despite the geometry showing a valid bore/plate structure

R3.method: Checked bore volume at (0, 2, 30) within face plate y=[0,4]

criteria.condition: Central bore diameter 22.5 mm through the face plate

R3.why: The script checks if the bore is clear by measuring intersection volume with a cylinder of radius 11.25+0.1. On the control cube (which has no bore), this check passes because the intersection is near zero, meaning it only tests for emptiness and not that the hole actually exists through the face pl
